The 2025 Tmall Double 11 sale will officially begin at 8 PM on October 20. On October 16, it was learned from the Tmall Double 11 press conference that this marks the 17th Tmall Double 11, the first Double 11 in the era of mass consumption, the first with comprehensive AI implementation, and the first with full participation from Taobao Flash Sales.

items.title: Sora 2 之后，北京人形WoW具身世界模型带来aha时刻

excerpt_i18n.en: In the pharmaceutical industry, drug information evolves rapidly, and the variety of new drugs continues to expand. At the same time, medication evaluations for special populations such as the elderly, children, and pregnant women often require extensive time to assess potential risks due to significant individual differences and complex drug interactions, posing major challenges for pharmacists. Traditional pharmacy services relying on manual expertise struggle to fully meet current clinical demands for medication safety and efficiency in terms of both speed and accuracy. With breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, the development and application of large AI models, through deep learning of clinical medication data, are expected to help optimize pharmacy workflows, improve medication service quality, and build a more reliable medication support system for both healthcare providers and patients. On October 16, Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital and Beijing Electronic Digital Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. (referred to as "BEDZ") entered into a strategic partnership. Leveraging BEDZ's "Spark·Medical Base," the two parties will collaborate on multiple "AI+healthcare" innovation areas, including jointly developing China's first large pharmacy model to make pharmacy services more precise and efficient. This strategic cooperation will deeply integrate Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital's extensive clinical practice and research experience with BEDZ's systemic strengths in full-stack AI infrastructure, trusted data services, and industry empowerment. It is understood that Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital is a "National Drug Clinical Trial Institution" approved by the China Food and Drug Administration, with 30 specialties currently qualified to conduct drug clinical trials, covering areas such as oncology, cardiovascular, neurology, and endocrinology.

El modelo tradicional de servicios farmacéuticos basado en la experiencia humana ya no puede satisfacer plenamente las necesidades actuales de seguridad y eficiencia en el uso de medicamentos en la práctica clínica. Con los avances en inteligencia artificial, mediante el aprendizaje profundo de datos clínicos de medicamentos, el desarrollo y aplicación de grandes modelos de IA tienen el potencial de optimizar los flujos de trabajo farmacéuticos, mejorar la calidad de los servicios de medicación y beneficiar tanto a médicos como a pacientes.
